mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_identity (user_id, provider, external_id, credential, display_hint, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{externalId}, #{credential}, #{displayHint}, #{failedLoginCount}, #{lockedUntil}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_identity SET credential = #{credential}, display_hint = #{displayHint}, failed_login_count = #{failedLoginCount}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, provider, external_id, credential, display_hint, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM user_identity WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, provider, external_id, credential, display_hint, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM user_identity WHERE provider = #{provider} AND external_id = #{externalId}

SELECT id, user_id, provider, external_id, credential, display_hint, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM user_identity WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
